key_insight: The paper argues for quality-assured intelligent welding in aerospace by linking real-time process monitoring to a digital closed-loop manufacturing workflow.
engineering_relevance: Its relevance is in enabling more reliable, traceable, and automatable welding of aerospace structures, where defects and variability have high cost and safety impact.
method: Monitor welding process signals in real time
Use the monitored data to infer quality status
Feed quality feedback into a closed-loop manufacturing control framework
evidence_signal: The abstract indicates this is a journal article in Journal of Manufacturing Processes, but it does not provide dataset size, experimental metrics, or reported performance values.
watch_item: Closed-loop deployment will depend on robust sensing, calibration, and generalization across different joints, materials, and shop-floor conditions.
paper_title: Toward quality-assured intelligent welding processes for aerospace structures: From process monitoring to digital closed-loop manufacturing
